title: Failing join test, then the standby base tells the owner the main is silent
goal: A standby base that misses the main base's heartbeats for N minutes sends one owner notice and one recovery notice
acceptance: A join test across two bases (Kaji link, heartbeat tracking, delivery) is committed failing first
After N minutes without heartbeats the standby sends one notice naming the base and the last heartbeat time; nothing repeats while the outage lasts
When heartbeats return it sends one recovery notice; a planned update restart inside the limit sends nothing
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a join test over two in-process bases plus the notice state; the report sized the whole at 6 h. Not a measurement.
